title: RetrievalResult
description: Schema for top-K chunk retrieval results from pgvector cosine similarity search.

schema_version.description: The version of this retrieval result schema.

query_embedding_dimensions.description: Dimensionality of the query embedding (must be 768).

k_returned.description: Number of results actually returned (may be less than requested if fewer chunks exist).

query_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of the query text for auditability (without storing raw query).

results.description: Array of retrieved chunks ordered by similarity (most similar first).

text_content.description: The text content of the chunk.

page.description: Page number in the source document (1-indexed).

rank.description: Rank position in the result set (1-indexed, 1 = most similar).

score.description: Cosine similarity score (1 - distance). Range 0.0 to 1.0 where 1.0 is identical.
